finding: GitHub reports the default main branch as protected=false with required status checks enforcement off. Current WFM safety/security workflows therefore run as evidence after a direct main update rather than being enforceable preconditions on that update.

correlation.risk_statement: If a direct main update modifies a deployment-sensitive watched path, the repository has no enforceable branch-level control proving required WFM gates passed before the new main state entered the staging deployment trigger surface.

current_impact.reason: Current main is unchanged during this inspection and the customer-proof service remains on the previously successful staging deployment.

containment: do not merge this evidence branch as a substitute for actual branch protection
use bounded PRs and exact-head checks for all automation-authored work
do not change Railway or sealed runtime controls to compensate for repository governance weakness
prevention: require relevant WFM security/integrity checks before main updates are accepted
disallow force-push and routine direct-push paths
rerun governance audit after any GitHub plan or repository-control change
regression_detection: The repository-governance audit must fail whenever GitHub reports main.protected != true.
